lead.event: IDEA shareholders approve Nawasena’s acquisition of a controlling stake
lead.headline: IDEA shareholders approve Nawasena’s acquisition of a 66.58% stake
lead.blurb: At an extraordinary meeting on 12 November, Idea Indonesia shareholders approved the transfer of 707.32 million shares to Nawasena for Rp38 billion, or Rp53.73 per share. Corporate Affairs Director Saskia Ayu Ajeng Aditya Putri said Nawasena plans to emphasize good corporate governance, strategic collaboration and human resource quality to support sustainable growth. Shareholders also approved changes to the boards and amendments to the articles on business classifications.

earnings_guidance.event: Conglomerate-owned banks report mixed nine-month 2026 profit results
earnings_guidance.headline: Conglomerate-owned banks report mixed nine-month profits, with BINA up 54.9%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Superbank's profit rose 398.77% to Rp299.88 billion, while Bank Mega's fell 16.86% to Rp1.82 trillion and Allo Bank's fell 11% to Rp338.1 billion. OJK said banking-industry profit grew 6.52% over the period, while articles cited rising funding costs and competition for low-cost deposits.

earnings_guidance.event: MNC Sekuritas lowers BBRI’s price target after third-quarter earnings
earnings_guidance.headline: MNC Sekuritas cuts BBRI price target despite 16% Q3 profit growth
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Rakyat Indonesia posted Q3 net profit of Rp16.8 trillion, up 16% year-on-year, while nine-month profit of Rp47.7 trillion equaled 80% of MNC Sekuritas and consensus forecasts for 2026. The earnings beat was driven by a 30.6% quarterly decline in credit loss provisions, as net interest income fell 7.6% and net interest margin narrowed to 7.4% year-to-date.

earnings_guidance.event: Mirae Asset downgrades BRMS and cuts its target price
earnings_guidance.headline: Mirae Asset downgrades BRMS to hold and cuts target price to Rp310
earnings_guidance.blurb: Mirae Asset Sekuritas Indonesia cut its target from Rp760, citing limited upside as the stock nears fair value. The broker projects net profit to rise 133% to US$81 million in 2027.

earnings_guidance.event: JSMR reports third-quarter 2026 operating and profit declines
earnings_guidance.headline: JSMR reports 2.57% net profit decline to Rp2.65 trillion through Q3 2026
earnings_guidance.blurb: Jasa Marga's revenue fell 1.23% to Rp20.82 trillion, as toll and other business gains were offset by construction revenue down 21.41%. BRI Danareksa Sekuritas analyst Abida Massi Armand projects EBIT growth of about 7% annually over 2026-2031 and recommends buying with a Rp4,750 target.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Merdeka Gold plans a private placement of 1.47 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: EMAS plans a private placement of 1.47 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The new shares would equal 10% of placed and paid-up capital, at a nominal Rp150 each and fully paid. Proceeds are allocated approximately 25% to working capital, 50% to business development and 25% to refinancing or settling obligations, subject to shareholder approval on 26 November.
